My gender is homophobis

I added that second part because getting to that space was a heck of a journey. That discourse from both cis-normative spaces and queer spaces made me feel like I wasn’t welcome to that label for a very long time

That most of my queer life was spent online since that was really the only place I was fully out as bi (looking back at a lot of my highschool friends we group together) But fandom spaces can get very toxic very fast. And in the early 2000’s there was a lot of binder discourse

But I don’t experience (a lot of, I’m unpacking some stuff) gender dysphoria. But I do get gender euphoria. Euphoria I never got to experience until well into my late 20’s So every so often I wonder what life would had been like if we were more open with people experimenting
